scope: Acceptance definitions only. This artifact records no WV-6 or WV-7 runtime, cross-OS, launch, or release proof.

contracts.title: Mac Air language-depth reconciliation

authoritySources.authority: WV-6 follows product convergence and belongs to the final reconciliation task.

authoritySources.anchor: Language depth and the missing Mac Air reconciliation
authoritySources.authority: Differences must be classified as contradiction, additional evidence, stale snapshot, or different scope; percentages must not be averaged.

entryConditions: P7-T1, P7-T2, and P7-T3 have converged on evidence-backed boundaries.
The source Mac Air language-depth report is present as a reviewable artifact.
Every proposed launch-scope change is tied to current code and reproducible current-tree evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Every Air-report delta is classified as contradiction, additional evidence, stale snapshot, or different scope.
Any claim without current code plus reproducible evidence remains partial, planned, or research.
No Air percentage is averaged with the truth-pulse or launch denominators.
The accepted scope and every deferral are recorded on the exact reviewed candidate.
scopeLimits: WV-6 does not prove browser execution, Shelf sealing, governance activation, production readiness, or cross-OS completeness.
Reference semantics do not become production claims without performance and failure evidence.
jonOnlyActions: Approve any language-depth scope expansion that changes the frozen launch candidate.
Decide whether a disputed Air-report delta enters launch scope or remains research debt.
Approve the base-merge gate for any resulting candidate change.

contracts.title: Frozen-candidate cross-OS and release handoff

authoritySources.authority: WV-7 and external launch messaging begin only after the live playground and Shelf are excellent and one candidate is frozen.

authoritySources.anchor: MIT archive and frozen-candidate release review
authoritySources.authority: The exact frozen candidate must be remeasured and replayed before Jon's release decision.

entryConditions: WV-6 is accepted or explicitly waived-with-reason by Jon.
The live browser and Minimum Sealed Shelf reporters are evidence-backed and green.
One exact candidate SHA is frozen without uncommitted changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Truth, launch-readiness, integrity, security, browser, Shelf, and platform replay evidence all name the same exact candidate SHA.
Windows, macOS, and Linux results remain separately labeled; WSL is never substituted for native Linux enforcement.
All four denominators and HOLD/FIRE posture are regenerated from reporter evidence.
No tag, publish, announcement, or release claim occurs inside the acceptance command.
scopeLimits: WV-7 is evidence for Jon's decision, not an autonomous FIRE decision.
A green repository gate cannot substitute for signing, notarization, promo QA, or platform-specific evidence.
jonOnlyActions: Approve the frozen candidate and base-merge gate.
Perform or authorize the human 31-to-32 governance activation ceremony.
Create any tag, publish any release, or make any public launch announcement.
